events: Walk to Lask; paid ride fulfilled. Orren hands letter to clerk and pays postage from own purse; local outgoing custody only.
Kaze spends one silver on food for three, six to five. Enters Veyr sale with Briar/Samira.

Veyr unveils actual Darkin ballista. Dresk seeks siege weapon for unnamed ridge hold. Driver reports prior harbor gate collapse caused route blockage, detour axle failure, half cargo loss and moved sale.
Kaze steps boundary rope, grabbed by guard, kills him through shield cart wheel; punches second guard through gallery. Second final fate unknown.
Crossbow bolt deflected on existing right forearm structure; Kaze breaks crane base, swinging chain kills crossbowman, wrecks platform/cash chest. No coins looted.
Spearman attacks Briar, cuts upper arm. She closes range, traps spear against closed pillory, headbutts/bites and kills guard. Blood feeding closes wound. Two guards flee.
Kaze stops ballista carriage before crew escape through service doors. Samira rescues nearby woman, draws pistol but fires no shots. Dresk and soldiers withdraw alive.
Close voice at actual weapon introduces Naganeka of Zuretta. She requests removal; no host, possession, manifestation, assimilation or projectile demonstration.
Kaze deliberately breaks front gate despite available wide rear service doors, steals intact ballista/carriage without paying. Pottery and merchant property damaged.
Orren disclaims further obligation. Outside east town pair discuss voluntary company/restraint; Naganeka does not agree to serve Kaze.
Kaze removes two modern transport bands only. Ancient prison intact. Trio continue with ballista, Dresk watches from town edge.
